info.name: Get a date fact for a specific month and day

params.name: json
params.description: Return the fact and associated metadata as a JSON object instead of plain text. Can also be triggered by setting the Accept or Content-Type header to application/json.

params.name: fragment
params.description: Return the fact as a sentence fragment that can be easily included as part of a larger sentence. The first word is lowercase and ending punctuation is omitted.

params.name: notfound
params.description: What to do if the number is not found. Options: `default` (return a pre-written missing message), `floor` (round down to the largest number with a fact), `ceil` (round up to the smallest number with a fact).

params.name: default
params.description: A custom message to return if no fact is found for the requested number. Used in conjunction with `notfound=default`.

params.name: callback
params.description: (Deprecated) JSONP callback function name. The response will be wrapped in a call to this function.

items.docs: Returns an interesting historical fact about the specified date (month/day). The number in the JSON response is the 1-indexed day of the leap year (e.g., 61 would be March 1st).
